hooks.command: /usr/bin/env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/opt/homebrew/bin ${HOME+"HOME=$HOME"} ${TMPDIR+"TMPDIR=$TMPDIR"} ${LANG+"LANG=$LANG"} ${HARNESS_NOTIFY+"HARNESS_NOTIFY=$HARNESS_NOTIFY"} ${HARNESS_NOTIFY_LOG+"HARNESS_NOTIFY_LOG=$HARNESS_NOTIFY_LOG"} ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR+"CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"} GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS=1 GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null /bin/bash -c '[ "${HARNESS_NOTIFY:-}" = off ] && exit 0; t0=$(date +%s); f() { printf "%s\n" "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"早期通知は動きませんでした（起動の前の確かめが成り立ちません: $1）。作業は止めていません。\"}}"; exit 0; }; g() { git --no-pager -c core.fsmonitor=false "$@" < /dev/null 2> /dev/null; }; r=$(g worktree list --porcelain | sed -n "1s/^worktree //p"); [ -n "$r" ] || f "根を決められない"; [ $(( $(date +%s) - t0 )) -lt 17 ] || f "時間切れ"; t=$(g -C "$r" ls-tree HEAD -- scripts/harness/notify-launch.sh); case "$t" in "100644 blob "*|"100755 blob "*) ;; *) f "HEAD の scripts/harness/notify-launch.sh が無いか、通常のファイルでない" ;; esac; o=${t#* blob }; o=${o%%[[:space:]]*}; s=$(g -C "$r" cat-file blob "$o"); [ -n "$s" ] || f "HEAD から scripts/harness/notify-launch.sh を取り出せない"; exec /bin/bash -c "$s" notify-launch "$1" "$r" "$t0"' notify-launch-hook codex
